figures.name: kirsch_error_vs_level
figures.caption: Worst relative error of the well-conditioned probes against the Kirsch closed form, per symmetry ray. Dashed: element-local pointwise protocol of the certification material. Solid: same displacement solution, production Barlow + area-weighted nodal recovery. Dotted line: 3 % acceptance.

figures.name: kirsch_conditioning
figures.caption: Relative error versus the size of the reference itself (finest level, radial and hoop probes). The dashed hyperbola is a fixed absolute error equal to the measured floor of the raw protocol: the measured points track it, so on small references the relative verdict reports the denominator, not the field. Dash-dot: 5 %-of-scale ill-conditioning boundary; dotted vertical: inherited 1 % withholding floor.

figures.name: kirsch_field_clouds
figures.caption: Quarter annulus R/a = 10 at the finest level: analytic radial stress, the recovered nodal field, and their pointwise difference (units of the far-field tension).
